text:
karly-support: Heads-up — Acme Analytics (INC-4582) reporting big tail latency (800-1200ms) for /v1/generate from EU users since ~05:10 UTC. They say requests target eu-west-1 but traces show a hop to us-west-2. Repro steps below.

karly-support: Repro (from customer):
1) POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate with API key X
2) region header: X-RW-REGION: eu-west-1
3) sample trace id: t-9a3b7f

Trace snippet from their opentelemetry export:
```
TraceID: t-9a3b7f
span[0] client -> edge-eu-west-1 (20ms)
span[1] edge-eu-west-1 -> routing-service (10ms)
span[2] routing-service -> compute-us-west-2 (780ms)
span[3] compute-us-west-2 -> model-host (15ms)
annotations: x-rw-region=eu-west-1 x-routing-decision=us-west-2-fallback
```

karly-support: They included a curl that reproduces: 
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -H 'X-RW-REGION: eu-west-1' \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

nina-support: I verified logs for that request-id on our proxy (edge-eu-west-1) and see a 502->retry to routing-service 05:10:22 UTC, then the routing decision header shows fallback.

eli-eng-runtime: @karly can you drop the full traceID and the original request_id from the customer? need to correlate with router logs. Also did customer pin a model version that isn't available in eu-west-1? fallback can happen if variant missing.

karly-support: request_id is r-3f4c9, trace id t-9a3b7f (both provided). They said they didn't pin a variant.

maya-sre: @eli i'll pull the router logs for edge-eu-west-1 around 05:10 - looking for capacity errors / 5xx. If router returned 5xx we might auto-fallback to nearest compatible region.

ben-eng-infra: Quick note — we had a candidate change to routing policy rolled 03/11 that tightened capacity checks; it's possible certain model allocations in eu-west-1 flagged as unavailable and routing picked us-west-2. I'll check the rollout window.

sam-platform: Can someone run a simulated request with debug headers? Use: 
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \
  -H 'X-RW-REGION: eu-west-1' \
  -H 'X-RW-Debug: trace,route' \
  -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
That should return X-RW-ROUTE headers on response and our debug route decision.

dave-network: Also please run a traceroute/dig from their IP if possible — need to confirm DNS for edge-eu-west-1 resolves to the correct anycast IP. Example from their host: 
```
$ dig +short api.redwood.ai
34.89.21.7  # should map to EU edge
$ traceroute 34.89.21.7
1  10.0.0.1
2  ...
12  34.89.21.7 (edge-eu-west-1)
```

ingress-bot: [deploy-bot] routing-policy v3.4 applied to eu-west-1 at 2026-03-11T03:09:12Z by ben-eng-infra :white_check_mark:

eli-eng-runtime: I pulled the router logs for r-3f4c9 — found: 
```
05:10:22 edge-eu-west-1 r-3f4c9 -> compute allocation check: no free allocation for model-x-8b in eu-west-1
05:10:22 routing-service decision: fallback to us-west-2 due to capacity_threshold
05:10:22 proxy returns 200 but with X-RW-ROUTE: us-west-2-fallback
```

eli-eng-runtime: So looks like expected fallback behavior but customer is surprised. We need to confirm if fallback should respect X-RW-REGION pin or if we should return a 4xx when region unavailable (customer expectation).

karly-support: Customer says they explicitly require EU-only. This is now an SLA/security concern. They've been billed at hosted egress rates for US compute. They want root cause and mitigation.

maya-sre: Short-term mitigation: block automatic inter-region fallback for customers with account flag eu_only=true. I can patch policy to return 409 region-unavailable instead of fallback. Anyone object?

ben-eng-infra: Agree patchable. Need a quick AB test + config flag. Will prepare config toggle and rollback plan.

sam-platform: Longer-term, we should add explicit header X-RW-REJECT-ON-FALLBACK that customers can set. But for now do the account-level flag per @maya.

nina-support: I'll tell customer we're pausing cross-region fallbacks for their tenant and will provide a timeline. Also will collect any other affected customers.

dave-network: Action items I need: (1) confirm DNS/anycast mapping for api.redwood.ai in EU, (2) confirm routing-policy roll 03/11 didn't change fallback thresholds unexpectedly, (3) verify model allocations in eu-west-1 for model-x-8b.

eli-eng-runtime: I'll attach the exact log lines and a proposed sentinel metric to alert when fallback_count by tenant > 0 in last 5m.

karly-support: Thanks team. Nina, I'll hand off to you for customer comms. Marking P1 for internal follow-up. :eyes:
